description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans grain activation and deactivation lifecycle, including scenarios such as activation, deactivation, reactivation, error handling, and special cases like long-running operations and activation failures.

classes.name: GrainActivateDeactivateTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the activation and deactivation lifecycle of Orleans grains, including various scenarios such as reactivation, failure handling, and edge cases.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, particularly clearing watcher state.

methods.name: WatcherGrain_GetGrain
methods.description: Verifies that a watcher grain can be successfully retrieved.

methods.name: Activate_Simple
methods.description: Tests that a grain is activated exactly once on first access.

methods.name: Deactivate_Simple
methods.description: Tests that the grain deactivation process triggers the appropriate lifecycle hook.

methods.name: Reactivate_Simple
methods.description: Verifies that a deactivated grain is reactivated correctly on subsequent access.

methods.name: Activate_TailCall
methods.description: Checks activation with tail call optimization patterns.

methods.name: Deactivate_TailCall
methods.description: Checks deactivation with tail call optimization patterns.

methods.name: Reactivate_TailCall
methods.description: Verifies reactivation of tail call grains after deactivation.

methods.name: LongRunning_Deactivate
methods.description: Tests deactivation of grains with long-running, reentrant operations.

methods.name: BadActivate_Await
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions during activation are propagated correctly.

methods.name: BadActivate_GetValue
methods.description: Checks that method calls fail properly if activation fails.

methods.name: BadActivate_Await_ViaOtherGrain
methods.description: Verifies that activation exceptions propagate through grain-to-grain calls.

methods.name: Constructor_Bad_Await
methods.description: Ensures that failures during grain construction are handled properly.

methods.name: Constructor_CreateGrainReference
methods.description: Verifies support for grain reference creation in constructors.

methods.name: TaskAction_Deactivate
methods.description: Tests deactivation behavior for grains that use Task-based activation patterns.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleWhileActivate
methods.description: Verifies handling of deactivation attempts during activation, expecting proper rejection.

methods.name: CheckNumActivateDeactivateCalls (overloads)
methods.description: Helper methods to verify the number of activation and deactivation calls recorded by the watcher.

methods.name: AssertIsNotInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Asserts that an exception is not an InvalidOperationException and contains expected message content.
